categories.main_business_segments: Huitongda Network Co., Ltd. operates primarily in two segments: commerce business and service business. The commerce business involves sales of merchandise including consumer electronics, household appliances, agricultural means of production, vehicles and auto parts, homebuilding and renovation materials, and liquor and beverages. The service business includes SaaS+ subscription services and merchant solutions, providing intelligent business and marketing software and related services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages digital technologies and supply chain capabilities to empower rural family-run stores. It focuses on digitalization infrastructure upgrades, AI applications such as intelligent customer service, AI-driven R&D, AI shopping assistants, and AI CRM private domain marketing. The SaaS+ platform integrates AI to optimize procurement, marketing, and store operations, supporting an AIaaS transformation. The company also develops own brands and integrates production-sales processes for vertical integration.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Huitongda serves a broad customer base including enterprise customers, channel customers, member retail stores, and individual consumers. Its primary market focus is on lower-tier cities and rural areas in China, empowering township family-run stores. The commerce business targets sectors such as consumer electronics, household appliances, agriculture, vehicles, homebuilding materials, and liquor. The service business targets merchants requiring SaaS+ and digital marketing solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in the People's Republic of China, with headquarters in Nanjing, Jiangsu Province. It has expanded its presence across 21 provinces and 25,000 townships in China, focusing on lower-tier markets. The principal place of business in Hong Kong supports its H-share listing and investor relations.
categories.supply_chain_position: Huitongda operates primarily as a midstream and downstream player in the supply chain. It integrates production and sales through own brand development and collaborates with leading brands and resource factories. The company builds a flexible supply chain network covering multiple categories and channels, including an AI-driven open platform supply chain system to meet diverse demands.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The strategic focus is on high-quality development emphasizing profitability, cash flow, and industrial upgrading. Key R&D directions include AI-driven digitalization, SaaS+ platform enhancement, AIaaS transformation, and development of new categories, channels, and business models. The company invests in AI applications for intelligent retail scenarios, edge computing, and intelligent terminals, while expanding own brand ecosystems and strategic partnerships.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of merchandise in the commerce business and subscription fees plus service fees in the SaaS+ service business. The commerce business recognizes revenue at a point in time from product sales, while the service business recognizes subscription fees over time and service fees at the point of service completion. Additional revenue streams include merchant solutions and other value-added services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, Huitongda positions itself as a leading industrial internet company in China focusing on lower-tier markets and rural retail ecosystems. It competes by leveraging digital technologies, supply chain integration, own brand development, and strategic collaborations with leading brands. The company has received recognition as a top industrial internet enterprise and maintains a strong market presence in its niche.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of RMB 60.06 billion, a 27.1% decrease from 2023, with a gross profit margin improvement to 3.8%. Net profit was RMB 462 million, with profit attributable to equity shareholders at RMB 270 million. The company has over 248,000 registered member retail stores and nearly 108,000 SaaS+ subscription users. Despite revenue decline due to strategic restructuring and market conditions, profitability and operational efficiency improved, indicating a transition to higher-quality growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Huitongda emphasizes creating value for rural family-run stores by combining digital technology empowerment with supply chain capabilities. Its unique value lies in integrating production and sales, developing own brands, and providing AI-powered SaaS+ solutions tailored for lower-tier markets. The company offers differentiated competitiveness through cost-effective supply chain services, intelligent marketing, and operational efficiency improvements, enabling small retail stores to enhance sales performance and customer satisfaction.
